Home / FAQ

Questions

Straight answers, including the awkward ones.

Answers on buying, renting, farm solutions, technology and data, and listing your own property. If yours is not here, ask us.

Buying

What does the smart tier actually change in the house?

The tier decides which devices are fitted and commissioned before handover. Basic covers lights, locks, sensors and metering. Comfort adds solar with storage, automated irrigation and zoned climate control. Premium adds whole-home battery backup, an EV charger, a monitored farm plot and priority support. The full device schedule for each tier is on the smart packages page.

Is the smart equipment included in the house price?

Yes. Every TRIXX-built home is priced with its tier included and commissioned. There is no separate installation invoice and no subscription for the core app features.

Can I change the tier after handover?

Yes. Our builds carry a service spine and spare conduit, so an upgrade from Basic to Comfort is typically four to eight days of work with the house occupied. Upgrading to Premium needs more space for the battery bank, which we plan for at design stage.

How do you verify an owner listing?

We check the title or lease, confirm the identity of the person listing, and send a surveyor to photograph and measure the property. Only then does the listing carry the verified badge. Listings that have not completed this are labelled as owner listings without the badge.

Do you help with a mortgage?

We work with Stanbic and two other lenders. Our team prepares the build record, valuation pack and smart-tier documentation that lenders ask for, and we can introduce you to a mortgage advisor at no cost.

Renting and tenant services

How do I pay rent?

Through TRIXX Rent in the app or the tenant portal on this site, by M-Pesa or card. You get a digital receipt immediately and your balance updates in the same minute.

How fast are repairs handled?

You log the request with photos in the app or the portal. We acknowledge within four working hours and target a 48-hour resolution for anything that affects habitability. The status is visible to you the whole time.

Does my login work across the apps?

Yes. One TRIXX account covers the website and all five apps. Register here once and you are already a user in Rent, Market, Home, Farm and School.

Farm solutions

Will the irrigation work without internet?

Yes. The controller holds the full schedule locally and keeps running on soil-moisture triggers if the connection drops. It syncs the log when it reconnects.

How much water will I actually save?

Between 26% and 42% depending on crop and soil, measured across our installed plots. The savings calculator on this site uses those measured figures and lets you enter your own water cost.

Do you install on land you did not develop?

Yes. Farm plot packages are installed on any plot with a water source and a pump. We survey first and give you a zone plan before quoting.

Technology, data and privacy

What camera and device data do you collect?

Cameras record to your local hub by default, and video stays there unless you switch on cloud backup. We receive device health, fault and usage metadata — for example that a sensor went offline or a battery dropped below 20% — so we can support you. We do not watch or review your video, and we do not sell device data to anyone. Full detail is in the privacy policy and the device data note.

Can I export or delete my data?

Yes. You can export your device history, energy logs and receipts as CSV from the app, and you can ask us to delete your account and associated data. We complete deletion requests within 30 days, except records we must keep for tax and lease law.

What happens if the internet goes down?

The hub runs automations, lighting, locks and irrigation locally. The app will not reach the house until the connection returns, but the house keeps working.

Listing your property

What does it cost to list?

Listing is free for the first thirty days. After that you choose a plan: Standard at KES 1,500 a month for one listing, Portfolio at KES 4,500 a month for up to five, or Agency at KES 12,000 a month for unlimited listings and a team dashboard. There is no commission on a sale.

Can I edit or withdraw a listing?

Yes, at any time from the owner dashboard. Withdrawn listings stop showing immediately and are removed from search results.

Do you moderate listings?

Every listing is reviewed before it goes live. We reject duplicate, misleading or unverifiable listings, and we suspend accounts that repeatedly breach the listing rules.

Still stuck?

Call, email or ask on WhatsApp. A person answers, not a bot.
